Now maybe support deep-link `?tab=stats` shortcuts. Manifest shortcuts specify `?tab=play` and `?tab=stats`, but app doesn't handle tab query. Need add small logic in app.js to activate tab from URL. Otherwise shortcuts don't do what they claim. Add near tab setup or at end:

```
const initialTab=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('tab');if(initialTab&&document.querySelector(`.tab[data-tab="${CSS.escape(initialTab)}"]`)) document.querySelector(...).click();
```

But this would run before restoreSession; restoreSession then clicks play if authenticated. That would override stats shortcut. Better adjust restoreSession to honor tab? Could simply not add shortcuts, or implement. The shortcuts are optional; could remove to avoid broken behavior. But deep link is nice. Implement after restoreSession? `restoreSession()` async, it clicks play on success. We can store desired tab and have restoreSession click that. Modify restoreSession? It's defined earlier in minified code: `async function restoreSession(){const ok=await refresh();if(ok){text('topStatus','CONNECTED');document.querySelector('[data-tab="play"]').click()}}`. Could change to `document.querySelector(`[data-tab="${new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('tab')||'play'}"]`)?.click()` but template literal within existing one-line. Better define function getInitialTab. But maybe simplest: remove shortcuts from manifest. They aren't required. The app has tabs; shortcuts add complexity. Could keep and handle at end after restore? Since restoreSession is async and likely finishes later, we can schedule a click after it. `restoreSession().then(()=>{...})` but it's called without await and not returned. Could change `restoreSession();` to `restoreSession().then(()=>{const tab=...;if(tab&&tab!=='play')document.querySelector(...).click()})`. That works: restoreSession resolves after refresh; if authenticated it clicks play then we click stats. If not authenticated, it still resolves and clicks stats. Fine.

But we don't need shortcuts. Simpler to remove them from manifest to keep scope tight. However PWA shortcuts are a nice "installed app" feature. Let's implement correctly with minimal change:

At end:
```
const initialTab=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('tab');if(initialTab&&/^[a-z]+$/.test(initialTab)){const tab=document.querySelector(`.tab[data-tab="${initialTab}"]`);if(tab)setTimeout(()=>tab.click(),0)}
```
This runs after restoreSession() call synchronously (restoreSession awaits fetch, so click happens before refresh returns, then refresh's play click overrides). So not good.

Change restoreSession's click line. We can edit the function string:
`async function restoreSession(){const ok=await refresh();if(ok){text('topStatus','CONNECTED');document.querySelector('[data-tab="play"]').click()}}`
to
`async function restoreSession(){const ok=await refresh();if(ok)text('topStatus','CONNECTED');const initial=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('tab');const tab=initial&&document.querySelector(`.tab[data-tab="${initial}"]`);(tab||document.querySelector('[data-tab="play"]')).click()}`

But this changes behavior: previously only clicked play if ok; now clicks play/stats always. That's fine; app starts on play tab by default anyway. But if no session, clicking play is current default. Good.

Need ensure no backticks conflict in edit tool. Fine. Let's do it.

Great.

Now reconsider `restoreSession` clicking play even when no session: Previously if no session, no click, but default tab is play already. Fine.

Potential bug: `const tab=initial&&document.querySelector(...)` where initial is arbitrary e.g. `?tab=" onmouseover=...` — querySelector could throw on invalid selector, breaking app. Manifest uses fixed values but a user could craft URL. Use `CSS.escape(initial)` or whitelist. Better whitelist: `const tab=initial&&/^[a-z]+$/.test(initial)&&document.querySelector(...)`. Add regex to avoid selector injection. `querySelector` with weird input could throw SyntaxError. Add `const tab=/^[a-z]+$/.test(initial||'')&&document.querySelector(...)`. Do that.

Current: `const initial=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('tab');const tab=initial&&document.querySelector(...)`.

Change to `const initial=new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('tab');const tab=initial&&/^[a-z]+$/.test(initial)&&document.querySelector(...)`. This returns false if invalid. Fine. Bump version again? Any app.js change after pwa4 requires bump. Let's do pwa5 at end.

- **`manifest.webmanifest`** — app name, standalone display, theme colors, 192/512 icons, maskable icon, and Play/Statistics shortcuts.
- **`icons/`** — generated app icons (192, 512, maskable 512, Apple 180, favicon 32).

- **`server.mjs`** — correct MIME types for `.webmanifest`, `.png`, `.svg`, and `.ico`.
- **`styles.css`** — install button/card styling and standalone safe-area spacing.
- **`README.md`** — install instructions.

- Manifest has no errors and Chrome reports the app as installable.
- Service worker registers and activates.
- Offline reload loads the full app shell from cache.
- Install controls appear outside standalone mode and hide when installed.
- `?tab=stats` shortcut opens the Statistics tab.

Live rolls, login, and balance still require a network connection.
